hook: A bug in Java's fastest Base64 decoder.
hookText: Java's fast Base64 decoder had a memory bug

beats.say: An OpenJDK pull request, number 32781, fixes issue 8392044: the AVX-512 Base64 decoder overwrites its output buffer on a short padded tail.
The bug sits in the x86-64 AVX-512 VBMI path of generate base64 decode block, the hand-tuned stub behind fast decoding.
Leftover tails of one to sixty-three bytes use a masked vector sequence that computes the output size as length over four, times three.
